total_station_count.long_description: Total number of EV charging stations within the county, counting each physical station once regardless of how many charger levels are installed. A higher count indicates more EV infrastructure density.
total_station_count.short_description: Total EV charging stations per county (count of unique stations).
total_station_count.provenance: Simulated EV charging station inventory for the va_2030_run30 scenario. Station lat/lon coordinates were spatial-joined to 2020 census county polygons. One station with multiple charger types is counted once in this measure.

l1_station_count.long_description: Number of EV charging stations within the county that have at least one Level 1 (120V) charger. Level 1 charging is the slowest and is typically used for overnight residential charging.
l1_station_count.short_description: EV charging stations per county with at least one Level 1 charger.
l1_station_count.provenance: Simulated EV charging station inventory for the va_2030_run30 scenario. Station lat/lon coordinates were spatial-joined to 2020 census county polygons. Each station is counted once per level it has, deduplicated within (county, level).

l2_station_count.long_description: Number of EV charging stations within the county that have at least one Level 2 (240V) charger. Level 2 is the most common public and workplace charging speed.
l2_station_count.short_description: EV charging stations per county with at least one Level 2 charger.
l2_station_count.provenance: Simulated EV charging station inventory for the va_2030_run30 scenario. Station lat/lon coordinates were spatial-joined to 2020 census county polygons. Each station is counted once per level it has, deduplicated within (county, level).

l3_station_count.long_description: Number of EV charging stations within the county that have at least one Level 3 (DC fast) charger. Level 3 stations support long-distance EV travel by enabling 20-80% charges in under an hour.
l3_station_count.short_description: EV charging stations per county with at least one Level 3 (DC fast) charger.
l3_station_count.provenance: Simulated EV charging station inventory for the va_2030_run30 scenario. Station lat/lon coordinates were spatial-joined to 2020 census county polygons. Each station is counted once per level it has, deduplicated within (county, level).

total_charger_count.long_description: Total number of individual chargers (across all levels) at all stations within the county. Higher charger counts indicate higher simultaneous-charging capacity.
total_charger_count.short_description: Total individual EV chargers per county (sum across all levels).
total_charger_count.provenance: Simulated EV charging station inventory for the va_2030_run30 scenario. Computed as the sum of l1_charger_count, l2_charger_count, and l3_charger_count from the source inventory, after spatial join to 2020 county polygons.

l1_charger_count.long_description: Total number of Level 1 (120V) chargers at all stations within the county. This is the slowest charging level and is uncommon in public stations.
l1_charger_count.short_description: Number of Level 1 chargers per county.
l1_charger_count.provenance: Simulated EV charging station inventory for the va_2030_run30 scenario. Sum of the l1_charger_count column from the source inventory after spatial join to 2020 county polygons.

l2_charger_count.long_description: Total number of Level 2 (240V) chargers at all stations within the county. Level 2 chargers are the workhorse of public EV charging — common at workplaces, shopping centers, and residential complexes.
l2_charger_count.short_description: Number of Level 2 chargers per county.
l2_charger_count.provenance: Simulated EV charging station inventory for the va_2030_run30 scenario. Sum of the l2_charger_count column from the source inventory after spatial join to 2020 county polygons.

l3_charger_count.long_description: Total number of Level 3 (DC fast) chargers at all stations within the county. Level 3 chargers enable rapid charging and are key infrastructure for highway corridors and travel destinations.
l3_charger_count.short_description: Number of Level 3 (DC fast) chargers per county.
l3_charger_count.provenance: Simulated EV charging station inventory for the va_2030_run30 scenario. Sum of the l3_charger_count column from the source inventory after spatial join to 2020 county polygons.
